normalization.pid: Compare parent-child relations and returned PID equality as booleans, never numeric IDs.
normalization.usage: Compare initialized timeval fields and nonnegative normalized values, never elapsed time.
normalization.ordering: Wait or pipe synchronization fixes stdout ordering; Rust spawn output occurs after wait.
normalization.addresses: No address or pointer values are printed.
normalization.signal: Compare raw wait status separately from outer exit status.
